title: Baggage
versionOrDate: OpenTelemetry baggage concept and security guidance reviewed 2026-08-02
relevance: Official guidance that baggage is propagated context, is not automatically a span, metric or log attribute, can cross into unintended downstream resources, and has no built-in integrity assurance. It anchors the lesson's rule to treat inbound baggage as untrusted, allowlist only decision-required values and never propagate secrets or regulated identifiers merely for convenient correlation.
